title: DTF Terpene Atlas laboratory/sample profile

fields.displayName: cultivar or sample label exactly as source reported
fields.cultivarName: normalized cultivar name when known; nullable
fields.source: lab report, publication or dataset citation
fields.method: GC-MS, GC-FID or other reported analytical method
fields.measurements: array of terpene id + value/range + qualifier + detection/quantitation metadata

rules: A cultivar name is not a measurement.
Never infer a percentage from another sample carrying the same strain name.
Retain below-LOD, below-LOQ and not-tested states distinctly from zero.
All measurements must identify their unit and source.
